resources.string: "Your walked places clear the fog. Tap to open the map."
"A nearby street or path to discover each week. Follow local signs and access rules."
"Save an encrypted backup before reinstalling. Keep its passphrase safe; it cannot be recovered."
"ovayuvam collects location data to reveal the places you visit and suggest nearby places to explore, even when the app is closed or not in use."
"Your exploration stays on this phone. You can pause tracking at any time. The map needs internet access to download map tiles."
"Your location, discoveries, visit counts and planned paths are stored on this phone. No account, advertising or location uploads to an ovayuvam server."
"The visible map comes from OpenFreeMap, using OpenStreetMap data. Map requests reveal your IP address and the requested map area to the map provider."
"Backups are encrypted with your passphrase. You choose where to save them, including a cloud drive through Android’s file picker. That provider’s privacy policy applies to files you save there."
"Pause tracking in settings or in the tracking notification. You can revoke location access in Android settings. Uninstalling removes your local world; export a backup first if you want to keep it."
"Pay attention to your surroundings and local access rules. Maps and suggestions may be inaccurate. They are not navigation or safety advice."
"Location permission is needed to reveal the map."
"Turn on Android Location to reveal the map."
"Remove all painted paths? Your visited places will be kept."
"Could not save this path. Try a shorter path or clear old plans."
"Enter the passphrase used for this backup. Your existing discoveries will be kept."
"Choose a passphrase for this backup. Keep it safe; it cannot be recovered."
"World imported. Your existing discoveries were kept."
"Encrypted world saved. Keep this file and its passphrase before reinstalling."
"The passphrase is incorrect, or the backup is damaged."
"File access was lost. Cancel and choose the file again."
"The file is unavailable. Download it to this phone, then choose it again."
"Could not read or save the file. Check the connection and free space, then try again."
"This is not a valid ovayuvam backup. Choose the original exported file."
"The backup could not be processed. Keep the original file and try again."
"A little unexplored corner nearby. Your weekly pin is waiting."
"Today you revealed about %1$s of your map."
"Today you walked about %1$s through the fog."
"A little more of your world is visible today."
